data.name: Pragya
data.gender_notes: Pragya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Pragya is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘prajna’ which means ‘wisdom’. It is a name given to a girl who is believed to possess deep understanding and knowledge. The name Pragya carries the meaning “Wisdom, Understanding” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Pragya usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom, understanding and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Pragya signifies a person who has gained true knowledge and wisdom through self-realization and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Pragya belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wisdom, Understanding.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pragya total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Pragya carries a significant cultural impact in the Hindu tradition. It is an honorary name given to a girl child, and especially to one who is exceptional in terms of intellect and knowledge. In the Hindu context, the name Pragya is synonymous with wisdom and sagacity. A Pragya is regarded as someone who brings wisdom and knowledge to society and is respected for her insights and understanding.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Pragya holds deep spiritual significance as well. In Hindu tradition, wisdom is considered a divine attribute, and a person who possesses it is considered to be closer to the divine. The name Pragya is believed to bless the child with the divine gift of wisdom and knowledge, enabling her to lead a noble and enlightened life. It is also believed that the name Pragya protects the child from ignorance andhelps her to understand the profound truths of life. Thus, the name Pragya represents a union of the material and the spiritual, and is a powerful reminder of the importance of knowledge and wisdom in leading a fulfilling and meaningful life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Pragya signifies wisdom and insight. It embodies the purified intellect, free from ignorance and illusions. The one who possesses Pragya is illuminated with the light of knowledge and truth.

vedic_reference.note: Pragya is a name mentioned in various Vedic scriptures. It is also considered as a name of Goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that The name Pragya is mentioned in the Mahabharata as a wise and intelligent woman. The name Pragya carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Pragya is associated with wisdom and intelligence in Hindu mythology.
